system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"can <USER> please bring out a feature that lets you list to 2 playlists at once?🤔 fed up of having to make a new playlist just to merge 2 old ones.."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> 1: Hi! Adding more info about the record label is a nice idea. You can help make it happen by voting here: <URL>"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply does not address customer's request about playing two playlists simultaneously."}
